$comment: `medium` is the one level of the canonical `detail` union that only Gemini has:
image_url.detail takes auto | low | high (the fourth value `original` is Responses-only,
and /v1/responses is a substrate item — decisions.md §7). The crossing rounds UP rather
than down, matching how ChatReasoningEffort narrows an effort the target lacks: a request
that costs a few more tokens is recoverable, one that silently loses resolution on a
document scan is not. Loud either way — a caller who wrote `medium` asked for something
